about: Every take of every re-shot Odyssey film, oldest first. The last take of a scene is the published films/odyssey/<scene>-performed.mp4; the earlier ones are kept here (a re-shoot never overwrites). Built from git history by the making-of tools.
policy: A re-shoot never overwrites: before a new cut (-r2) is renamed over <scene>-performed.*, the current film moves to films/odyssey/takes/<scene>/take<N>.* (mp4, jpg poster, vtt, json) and gets its entry in this file.

scenes.name: The Raft
scenes.why: Calypso's lines were hidden behind Odysseus.

takes.summary: First take. Calypso and Odysseus stand pressed together at the trees, so the only clear cameras left were overhead, and her lines play partly behind his head and the bow on his back.
takes.next_changed: Re-staged: the two stand a man's height apart, step in only for the axe and apart again, so her lines (6-30 s) are held on her own face.
takes.commit_message: The Raft performed and shot by the cinematographer (62 s, 9 shots legal; Calypso's lines partly behind Odysseus's head and bow noted on the camera page, the two pressed together leaving the solver only overhead cameras); the hub's card, the home page and the camera page

takes.summary: The same scene re-staged with room between them: a mid, an over-the-shoulder past Odysseus and a close on Calypso while she names the trees.
takes.commit_message: The Raft re-staged and re-shot (62 s, 9 shots legal): Calypso and Odysseus stand a man's height apart at the trees, step in only for the axe and apart after it, so her lines (6-30 s) are held on her own face; the Stake's score keeps its homeostat's parameters after the giant's turn was authored; the camera page's note says what is still wrong

scenes.name: The Horse Song
scenes.why: The first take held one wide of the wooden horse for 51 seconds.

takes.summary: First take. Odysseus was not drawn until he waits inside the horse, so for its first 51 s the camera had nobody to cut to and held one static wide of the horse.
takes.next_changed: Re-staged in Alcinous's hall: the bard sings while Odysseus listens, weeps into his cloak, and the king notices, stops the lyre and asks his name; 12 shots, all legal.
takes.commit_message: The Horse Song performed and shot by the cinematographer (56 s, 2 shots; its first 51 s hold one wide of the horse because Odysseus is not drawn until he waits inside it, noted on the camera page as a staging fault); the hub's card, the home page and the camera page

takes.summary: The song performed in the hall, with the listener's tears and the king's question; 12 shots legal.
takes.commit_message: The Horse Song re-staged in Alcinous's hall and re-shot (56 s, 12 shots legal): Demodocus sings, Odysseus listens, draws his cloak and weeps, Alcinous notices, rises, stops the lyre and asks his name, Odysseus stands to answer; the camera page's note says what is still wrong

takes.next_changed: the lotus's bliss performed as drugged motion (DROWSE) instead of still holds

takes.summary: Take 2: the Lotus-eaters and the drugged scouts sway, nod and reach for the flowers (DROWSE on its own layer); the opening and the landing wide are as still as before

scenes.name: Polyphemus Seals the Cave
scenes.why: The great stone did not read as the giant's doing.

takes.next_changed: The great stone is now carried into the doorway with the giant's heave (a new engine feature: a set piece carried by a body), and the sealed cave and the milking are lit.
takes.commit_message: Polyphemus Seals the Cave performed and shot by the cinematographer (42 s, 10 shots legal): the wood's crash, the flock in, the stone heaved into the door, the milking and the fire, the eye on the men; the hub's card, the home page and the camera page (its note says what is still wrong)

takes.summary: The stone travels with the giant's arms into the doorway; the sealed cave and the milking lit.
takes.commit_message: Polyphemus Seals the Cave re-shot (42 s, 10 shots legal): the great stone carried into the door with the giant's heave, the sealed cave and the milking lit; the camera page's note and data

scenes.name: The Name Nobody and the Stake
scenes.why: The wine was offered to the back of the giant's head.

takes.summary: First take: the cave by firelight, the stake cut and hardened, the lots, the wine, the name; 13 shots legal, exposure checked.
takes.next_changed: Re-shot from 43 s and spliced over the first cut (its sound kept): the giant turns round at his seat to face the men, the wine is offered to his face in a low two-shot, then he drinks.
takes.commit_message: The Name Nobody and the Stake performed and shot by the cinematographer (68 s, 13 shots legal, the exposure checked); the hub's card and the camera page; another man before a close's face counts as foreground

takes.summary: The giant turns to the men and the offer is seen face to face.
takes.commit_message: The Name Nobody and the Stake re-shot from 43 s (spliced over the first cut, its sound kept): the giant turns round at his seat to the men, the wine is offered to his face in a low two-shot from beside Odysseus, then the giant drinks over his shoulder; the camera page's note says what is still wrong

scenes.name: Escape beneath the Rams
scenes.why: Cameras ended up inside rams and in black night.

takes.summary: First published take with the creature camera (72 s): some frames from inside a ram's body or a face, a night wide almost black.
takes.next_changed: Re-shot: no frame inside a ram or a face, the black night wide refused for a lit mid on the lead ram, the closing wide moved off the fleece.
takes.commit_message: Escape beneath the Rams performed, with the creature camera (72 s): the hub card and the home page

takes.summary: The escape under the rams, every camera outside the animals and every frame exposed.
takes.commit_message: Escape beneath the Rams re-shot with the creature camera: no frame inside a ram or a face, the night wide refused for its blackness (a lit mid on the lead ram), the closing wide off the fleece; the camera page's contact sheet

scenes.name: The Laestrygonian Harbour
scenes.why: The opening wides showed Odysseus's back.

takes.summary: First cut (never published): the opening wides look at Odysseus's back, and a wide of a giant runs on into empty sky before the giant is there.
takes.next_changed: The solver learned two rules: a wide on a man prefers his front, and a shot whose figures are gone becomes a wide on a man who is present. 13 shots legal.
takes.commit_message: Work in progress: the Laestrygonian Harbour performed (35 s, first cut; its contact sheet shows the opening wides on Odysseus's back and a giant's wide run on into sky), the solver's fix for both (a wide on a man prefers his front and refuses to cut him; a shot whose figures are gone at its middle becomes a wide on a man present instead of running the shot before on), plans for the scar, father and son, the cattle, the rite, Aeolus, Proteus and the swineherd's dogs

takes.summary: Odysseus's front in the opening wides, no wide of a giant not yet drawn.
takes.commit_message: The Laestrygonian Harbour performed and re-shot by the cinematographer (35 s, 13 shots legal; the re-shot replaces the unpublished first cut): Odysseus's front in the opening wides, no wide of a giant not yet drawn; the hub's card, the home page and the camera page; the performance page takes a re-shot film

scenes.name: Circe
scenes.why: Frames from inside the pig sties and of empty sky.

takes.next_changed: Re-shot: no frame inside the pig stacks or of empty sky, Eurylochus framed from in front, the swine pens in a wide. The solver now refuses a close on the back of a head and a flat frame.
takes.commit_message: Circe performed and shot by the cinematographer (52 s, 19 of 20 shots legal); the hub's card and the camera page. The solver now refuses a close or mid on the back of a man's head and a flat frame (one surface against the lens), both seen in Circe's contact sheet

takes.summary: Circe's house, the men turned to swine, Eurylochus's report face to the lens.
takes.commit_message: Circe re-shot (third cut): no frame inside the pig stacks or of empty sky, Eurylochus's report framed from in front (his face to the lens), the swine pens wide; 19 shots legal

scenes.name: Hermes and the Moly
scenes.why: Two-shots showed one speaker from behind.

takes.summary: First cut (under review): some two-shots of Hermes and Odysseus show one of the two from behind.
takes.next_changed: The solver now refuses a two-shot that shows either man of the conversation from behind, and a wide that shows a speaker's back.

scenes.name: Anticleia and the Three Embraces
scenes.why: His mother looked alive; the embraces had nothing to pass through.

takes.summary: First take: the blood, the knowing, the longing, three embraces that close on nothing; but Anticleia is drawn as a solid living figure.
takes.next_changed: Anticleia drawn as a shade (translucent and pale, a new engine feature), and each embrace passes through her before she is a step farther off.
takes.commit_message: Anticleia and the Three Embraces performed and shot by the cinematographer (54 s, 13 shots legal): the blood, the knowing, the longing, three embraces that close on nothing; the hub's card, the home page and the camera page (its note says what is still wrong)

takes.summary: The mother as a shade, his arms closing through her three times.
takes.commit_message: Anticleia and the Three Embraces re-shot (54 s, 13 shots legal): Anticleia drawn as a shade, each embrace passing through her before she is a step farther off; the camera page's note and data

scenes.name: Achilles Chooses Life in Retrospect
scenes.why: Achilles never said the line the scene is famous for.

takes.summary: First take (62 s): the shades, the praise, the son, the stride across the asphodel, Ajax silent; but Achilles's answer is missing, and the dead look like the living.
takes.next_changed: His answer added as a new turn and spoken on a close of his face (rather a hired man alive than king over all the dead); the four shades drawn translucent and pale; Patroclus and Antilochus bareheaded. 74 s, 14 shots.
takes.commit_message: Achilles Chooses Life in Retrospect performed and shot by the cinematographer (62 s, 11 shots legal): the shades, the praise, the son, the stride across the asphodel, Ajax silent; the hub's card, the home page and the camera page (its note says what is still wrong)

takes.summary: Achilles answers on his own close, among pale shades.
takes.next_changed: the leaked stage direction 'No. I will not reconciliation and withdraws in silence.' dropped from the cut: the silent exit plays silent
takes.commit_message: Achilles Chooses Life in Retrospect re-shot (74 s, 14 shots legal): his answer spoken on a close of his face (rather a hired man alive than king over all the dead, an added turn), the four shades drawn translucent and pale, Patroclus and Antilochus bareheaded; the camera page's note and data

takes.summary: Take 3: take 2's picture to 'Achilles strides away rejoicing.', the garbled last narration, its caption and the 6 s still mid after it gone

takes.summary: The tale finished, the gifts, the evening boarding; 6 shots legal.

takes.next_changed: The beggar's retort restored to the cut and shot, and the stool seen in the air on its arc to his shoulder (a new engine feature: props in flight). 72 s, 16 shots.
takes.commit_message: Antinous Throws the Stool performed and shot by the cinematographer (56 s, 13 shots legal): the begging, the railing, the stool, the blow taken standing, the curse, the rebuke; the hub's card, the home page and the camera page (its note says what is still wrong)

takes.summary: The retort spoken, the stool thrown and seen on its arc.
takes.next_changed: Take 3 (Hearts of Plastic's experiment, odyssey/experiments/OD-B17-S05.json): the stool's flight 0.33 s -> 0.6 s, its arc raised with it, smear bricks on the two drawings after the release (the stool drawn long in bricks along its path, after The LEGO Movie), and the cut to the wide moved before the release so the whole flight and the landing are in one shot.
takes.commit_message: Antinous Throws the Stool re-shot (72 s, 16 shots legal): the beggar's retort restored to the cut and shot, the stool seen in the air on its arc to his shoulder; the camera page's note and data

takes.summary: The stool in the air for six tenths of a second, two drawings of smear bricks, landing in the frame.

scenes.name: The making-of film
scenes.why: The first cut was a slide show: footage, screenshots and title cards under a narration. The director asked for a LEGO film instead, acted by minifigures. Then the director asked for the halfworld's origins and the agents' assembly, and the film gained a second part.

takes.summary: The explainer cut (4 min 19 s): the films and their kept takes, keyframe stills, screenshots of the engine's pages and the cinematographer's sheets, title cards drawn as LEGO in chromium, narrated by one synthetic voice (Kokoro-82M, af_heart). Built by tools/making/making_of.py.
takes.next_changed: Made into a LEGO film: minifigures in a LEGO film studio (a director, the agent, a cinematographer, Odysseus, an examiner) act out how the project was made, staged and performed by the same engine as the Odyssey's scenes, with a Kokoro voice for each character. No slides.
takes.commit_message: The making-of film (films/odyssey/making-of.mp4, 4 min 19 s, 1280x720, captions and poster; a 44 s cut beside it)

takes.summary: A LEGO film, 4 min 29 s: in one LEGO film studio (tools/making/studio.py) the director, the agent, the cinematographer, Odysseus and the examiner act out how the project was made, in four scenes performed by the engine and shot by the cinematographer as the Odyssey's scenes are (OD-B25-S01..S04): the characters do nothing; the camera in the ram's wool, the render farm at night and the restart; the 95 MB wall and keep both; the ledger read from the forensic report, and make it a film. A Kokoro-82M voice for each character, synthetic, said in the end caption.
takes.next_changed: Part two added: four more scenes in the same studio (OD-B25-S05..S08) act out the origins chapter of the forensic report: the halfworld's adaptation prompt and atlas, the loom of agents building the last eight books in one tree (the session cap, the git add -A sweep and its fix, the skip list), the voices (a stage direction spoken aloud, 706 of 706 lines, re-recorded in batches; the music credited only to Treblo), and the bridge into LEGO with this session's parent and helpers. A sixth figure, the sweeper.
takes.commit_message: The making-of as a LEGO film (films/odyssey/making-of.mp4, 4 min 29 s, 1280x720, captions with speaker names, poster)

takes.summary: The full LEGO film, 9 min 46 s, in two parts in one studio. Part one (OD-B25-S01..S04): the characters do nothing; the camera in the wool and the night; the 95 MB wall and keep both; the ledger. Part two, the origins (OD-B25-S05..S08): the card and the atlas; the loom at night (the cap, the sweep, the skip list); the voices; the bridge into LEGO and the helpers. Kokoro-82M voices, one per character, synthetic.

stages.name: The Gate (Athena at the threshold)
stages.note: The first scene made, and the one every stage was tried on first.

steps.what: The first voiced scene: the set, the voices, faces with lip sync, captions; the camera cut on header cards. The characters stand at their marks and do nothing.
The Regulars' Cut: the same scene edited down with real camera framings (wides, mids, closes) chosen by the cutting grammar. Still nobody acts.
Hand choreography laid on the cut: gestures, turns, walks keyed by hand on the rigs.
Performed by the engine: every movement caused by an intent in the score (welcome, offer, take), compiled to a body sheet and rendered.
Performed by the engine with the cinematographer's plan: the rowers on one clock, the binding to the mast.
Hand choreography: the leap, the bow, the arrow, the fall, the hall erupting.
Performed and shot by the cinematographer: the engine's causal chain, 22 shots all legal.
Performed by the engine with the giant as a rig, but shot with the cameras planned from the blocking alone.
Shot by the cinematographer from the performance: the camera goes where the heat is, every camera tested against the set.
First cut with the creature camera: closes on the rams too near, kept for comparison.
The published film after two more takes (see the takes below).
